messages:
Dana (Partnerships): Quick announce  Aurora TeleMed signed a 6-week HIPAA pilot via an AWS Marketplace Private Offer. They want Redwood Private in their VPC for clinical summarization + redaction. Big win for partner GTM with HealthCloud MSP. :tada:
Mateo (Sales): Nice! Private Offer ID PM-77821 confirmed. Is billing via Marketplace or a direct SOW?
Priya (Legal): We have a short data processing addendum drafted. Need customer signature before data access. I'll email the DPA and note the AWS Marketplace terms.
Dana (Partnerships): Billing via Marketplace Private Offer for the pilot; options to move to Dedicated contract post-pilot. Mateo, please loop the MSP partner manager.
Noah (Eng): Tech notes: we'll deploy in customer's subnet, enable VPC endpoints, and configure S3 encryption with customer KMS. Need to confirm model size and sequence length distribution for perf planning.
Cara (Customer Success): Onboarding kickoff set for Tue 9am ET. Aurora asked for weekly checkpoints and a short case study if outcomes are positive. They also want a compliance attestation for audit purposes.
Mateo (Sales): Target expansion metrics: p95 latency < 100ms, throughput 300 qps at 256 seq, and PII redaction F1 > 0.92 for the summarization model.
Noah (Eng): From runtime ops: enable prefix caching, conservative batching, and monitor KV cache warm-up. We'll pin model to ensure deterministic perf. Also adding a small perf harness for the sample corpus.
Dana (Partnerships): Marketing wants to prep a customer quote and a short spotlight. MarketingBot, can you reserve a page in the partner case study queue?
MarketingBot (bot): Case study slot reserved: CS-2026-12. Please upload draft artifacts within 4 weeks.
Priya (Legal): Note: Marketplace Private Offer includes AWS terms; ensure we have Aurora signature on both the Private Offer and our DPA. I'll add checklist to the ticket.
Cara (Customer Success): I'll collect the customer's SOC/HIPP A contact info and request their security questionnaire. Also will schedule the first metrics review 1 week after onboarding.
Noah (Eng): Posting minimal infra snippet for the infra team to review:
```
aws_marketplace_private_offer: PM-77821
vpc_config:
  subnet_ids: [subnet-0abc, subnet-0def]
  vpc_endpoints: [com.amazonaws.s3, com.amazonaws.ec2]
models:
  - name: clinical-summary-2026
    pin: v2.0.3
    seq_max: 256
    quantization: fp16
kms:
  key_arn: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01
```
Dana (Partnerships): Ops created ticket #PM-5592 for onboarding artifacts and security checklist. Thanks team  big shoutout to Mateo and Cara for driving this.
Mateo (Sales): Will coordinate executive intro and ask for a short customer quote during week 4.
Cara (Customer Success): Volunteers for case study write-up? I can draft a technical + outcome section. Need 1-2 logos and a short quote.
Dana (Partnerships): I'll follow up in #marketing with assets. Keeping this thread for coordination; reply here with any blockers. :rocket:
